item.title: Monte Carlo Simulation
item.description:
Welcome to the Monte Carlo Simulation & Computational Uncertainty scratchpad. This curriculum is designed as an interactive, scrollytelling learning journey exploring how pseudo-randomness can be transformed into a computational instrument for scientific estimation, high-dimensional integration, Bayesian inference, and decision-making under deep uncertainty.

Each page in this series pairs rigorous mathematical foundations (convergence proofs, variance formulations, Central Limit bounds) with interactive scrollytelling visualizers and vectorized Python implementations (NumPy/SciPy). The running case studies are grounded in civil infrastructure resilience, transportation network reliability, disaster evacuation dynamics, electric vehicle charging demands, and extreme weather risk analysis.
